Kehel

Overview

Kehel is a disgraced necromancer living in the Last Shelter. Bitter about the Guild’s intrigues, he interprets generosity and honour as disguises for greed and revenge. He asks Zak to destroy a harpy from his experiments and directs the search for At-Zako toward Joon scholars and the rival necromancer Kholai. He recognises that the teleport amulet’s destination can only be read by a Great Magician. [1, 2, 3, 4]

Kholai and the dead scientist

Kehel directs Zak to Kholai, whom Taivo displaced from the imperial laboratory. Kholai wants disgrace for his rival rather than a simple assassination. Zak steals a dead scientist’s head from the laboratory; its disappearance will embarrass Taivo, and Kholai can summon its spirit. The scientist describes a horror pursuing the red-skinned youth. To conceal him, the scholars changed his appearance and sent him away by teleportation. Kholai interprets the broken testimony and tells Zak to search the ruined mansion for the magical object used in the escape. The fragments Zak finds are beyond Kehel’s ability to interpret: only a Great Magician can identify the destination. [3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 4]
